changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_person_name(t text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$ SELECT public.unaccent('public.unaccent'::regdictionary, lower(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(t, '')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_phone(t text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$ SELECT CASE WHEN length(d) = 11 AND left(d, 2) = '48' THEN substr(d, 3) WHEN length(d) = 13 AND left(d, 4) = '0048' THEN substr(d, 5) ELSE d END FROM (SELECT regexp_replace(coalesce(t, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS d) digits $$

changeSet.sql: WITH avatar_catalog AS ( SELECT 'avatar' || n || '.png' AS avatar, n AS ord FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS n ), keepers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.avatar) u.id FROM users u JOIN avatar_catalog c ON c.avatar = u.avatar ORDER BY u.avatar, u.id ), to_fix AS ( SELECT u.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.id) AS rn FROM users u WHERE u.avatar IS NOT NULL AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM keepers) ), free_avatars AS ( SELECT c.avatar, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.ord) AS rn FROM avatar_catalog c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.avatar = c.avatar) ) UPDATE users u SET avatar = f.avatar FROM to_fix t LEFT JOIN free_avatars f ON f.rn = t.rn WHERE u.id = t.id

changeSet.createView: SELECT kii.product_id AS product_id, 'KSEF' AS source_type, kii.id AS source_id, ki.issue_date AS purchase_date, CAST(COALESCE(kii.net_value / NULLIF(kii.declared_quantity, 0), kii.unit_net_price) AS NUMERIC(15,4)) AS unit_net_price, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(15,4)) AS unit_gross_price, kii.declared_quantity AS quantity, kii.vat_rate AS vat_rate FROM ksef_invoice_item kii JOIN ksef_invoice ki ON ki.id = kii.invoice_id WHERE kii.product_id IS NOT NULL AND kii.declared_quantity IS NOT NULL AND kii.declared_quantity > 0 UNION ALL SELECT cei.product_id AS product_id, 'MANUAL' AS source_type, cei.id AS source_id, ce.expense_date AS purchase_date, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(15,4)) AS unit_net_price, CAST(cei.price * COALESCE(ce.exchange_rate, 1) AS NUMERIC(15,4)) AS unit_gross_price, cei.quantity AS quantity, cei.vat_rate AS vat_rate FROM company_expense_item cei JOIN company_expense ce ON ce.id = cei.company_expense_id WHERE cei.product_id IS NOT NULL AND cei.quantity IS NOT NULL AND cei.quantity > 0

changeSet.author: Wojtek
changeSet.createView: SELECT 'MANUAL' AS source_type, ce.id AS source_id, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS source_item_id, ce.expense_date AS expense_date, ce.category AS category, CAST(ce.total_net AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_net, CAST(ce.total_vat AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_vat, CAST(ce.total_value AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_value, ce.seller_id AS seller_id FROM company_expense ce WHERE ce.category <> 'MIXED' UNION ALL SELECT 'MANUAL' AS source_type, ce.id AS source_id, it.item_id AS source_item_id, ce.expense_date AS expense_date, it.category AS category, CAST(ROUND(it.gross - it.vat, 2) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_net, CAST(it.vat AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_vat, CAST(ROUND(it.gross, 2) AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_value, ce.seller_id AS seller_id FROM ( SELECT g.item_id, g.company_expense_id, g.category, g.gross * g.rate AS gross, ROUND(ROUND(g.gross * g.vat_percent / (100 + g.vat_percent), 2) * g.rate, 2) AS vat FROM ( SELECT cei.id AS item_id, cei.company_expense_id AS company_expense_id, cei.category AS category, CAST(cei.price AS NUMERIC) * cei.quantity AS gross, CAST(COALESCE(ce.exchange_rate, 1) AS NUMERIC) AS rate, CAST(CASE cei.vat_rate WHEN 'VAT_23' THEN 23 WHEN 'VAT_8' THEN 8 WHEN 'VAT_7' THEN 7 WHEN 'VAT_5' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS NUMERIC) AS vat_percent FROM company_expense_item cei JOIN company_expense ce ON ce.id = cei.company_expense_id ) g ) it JOIN company_expense ce ON ce.id = it.company_expense_id WHERE ce.category = 'MIXED' UNION ALL SELECT 'KSEF' AS source_type, ki.id AS source_id, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS source_item_id, ki.issue_date AS expense_date, ki.category AS category, CAST(ki.net_amount AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_net, CAST(ki.vat_amount AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_vat, CAST(ki.gross_amount AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_value, ki.seller_id AS seller_id FROM ksef_invoice ki JOIN ksef_seller ks ON ks.id = ki.seller_id

changeSet.createView: SELECT ('MANUAL-' || ce.id) AS unified_id, ce.id AS source_id, 'MANUAL' AS source_type, ce.source AS source, ce.expense_date AS expense_date, ce.category AS category, CAST(ce.total_net AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_net, CAST(ce.total_vat AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_vat, CAST(ce.total_value AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_value, CAST(false AS BOOLEAN) AS awaiting_product_verification, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS seller_default_expense_category, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_type, ce.seller_id AS seller_id, CAST(ce.currency AS VARCHAR(3)) AS currency, CAST(ce.total_value_currency AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_value_currency FROM company_expense ce UNION ALL SELECT ('KSEF-' || ki.id) AS unified_id, ki.id AS source_id, 'KSEF' AS source_type, ks.name AS source, ki.issue_date AS expense_date, ki.category AS category, CAST(ki.net_amount AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_net, CAST(ki.vat_amount AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_vat, CAST(ki.gross_amount AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_value, ki.awaiting_product_verification AS awaiting_product_verification, ks.default_expense_category AS seller_default_expense_category, ki.invoice_type AS invoice_type, ki.seller_id AS seller_id, CAST('PLN' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS currency, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC(15,2)) AS total_value_currency FROM ksef_invoice ki JOIN ksef_seller ks ON ks.id = ki.seller_id
